_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Base rate is brutal — only 5% of 12h windows move ±2+ points — and with liquidity factors deteriorating against a bullish analog, the coil holds until either ETF flows recover or VIX breaks 20 with DXY strengthening.
next_move.brains_agree: Split — analyst says HOLD with medium conviction citing broken fuel lines and poor direction accuracy; narrative implies accumulation is underway but provides no explicit forward direction call.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows turn positive and stablecoin growth recovers above 45 — liquidity engines restart, validating Panic→Denial→Anxiety recovery path
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX breaks above 20 with DXY strengthening through 101 — risk-off accelerates, pushing down to Capitulation (16-23) and killing the bottom analog
